title: PlusAI, which is operating autonomous freight routes in Texas with trucking company Ryder, plans to go public in a SPAC deal at an $800M pre-money valuation (Pragyan Kalita/Reuters)
summary: Pragyan Kalita / Reuters: PlusAI, which is operating autonomous freight routes in Texas with trucking company Ryder, plans to go public in a SPAC deal at an $800M pre-money valuation — PlusAI has agreed to go public through a merger with blank-check firm Texas Ventures Acquisition III Corp (TVA.O) …
